description: ts-optimize for Codex: resume pointer, tsc/knip command guard, commit guard. Silent unless a run is open or a guarded command is typed.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; d=$PWD; while :; do [ -f "$d/.ts-optimize/state/open-run" ] && break; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && exit 0; n=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$n" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$n; done; exec node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/hooks/session-start.mjs"

command -v node >/dev/null || exit 0; d=$PWD; while :; do [ -f "$d/.ts-optimize/state/open-run" ] && break; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && exit 0; n=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$n" = "$d" ] && exit 0; d=$n; done; exec node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/hooks/commit-guard.mjs"
